    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n, m = map(int, input[0].split())
    s = input[1]
    t = input[2]

    if '*' not in s:
        if s == t:
            print("YES")
        else:
            print("NO")
        return

    prefix, suffix = s.split('*', 1)
    prefix_len = len(prefix)
    suffix_len = len(suffix)

    if prefix_len > m or suffix_len > m:
        print("NO")
        return

    if t.startswith(prefix) and t.endswith(suffix):
        if prefix_len + suffix_len <= m:
            print("YES")
        else:
            print("NO")
    else:
        print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
